label: Jury Duty Summons
subject: Official Jury Duty Summons
body:
Dear Jane M. Doe,

You have been randomly selected for jury service in the Superior Court of California, County of Alameda. Your official summons is attached as a PDF to this email.

Please open and read the attached document carefully. It contains your juror number, reporting date, time, courthouse address, case docket number, and instructions for confirming your appearance.

You are required to confirm your service no later than 11:59 PM on Friday, June 12, 2026. You may confirm online at www.alameda.courts.ca.gov/jury or by phone at (510) 891-6011. If you require a postponement or believe you qualify for a hardship excusal, instructions are included in the attached summons.

This is an official communication from the court. Failure to appear without an approved postponement or excusal may result in sanctions, including fines up to $1,500.

Do not reply to this email address; it is not monitored. For questions, contact the Jury Commissioner's Office during business hours.

Office of the Jury Commissioner
Superior Court of California, County of Alameda
1225 Fallon Street, Oakland, CA 94612
